channel.title: The Tech Docket
channel.description: Daily signal on tech & AI — what the world is searching, and why

item.title: CERT-In CIAD-2026-0062: AI Agents & Payment Workflow Fraud
item.description: CERT-In critical advisory CIAD-2026-0062 warns of payment workflow manipulation and AI-driven agentic attacks across Indian banks, fintechs, and vendors.

item.title: Cursor Weighs Dropping Chinese AI as Sarvam Sells DeepSeek
item.description: A 50-page US House report reveals Cursor, Airbnb, and DoorDash rely on Chinese open-weight models, even as India's Sarvam hosts DeepSeek at 450B tokens daily.

item.title: Global Tech Layoffs 2026: Statutory Filings vs. Headlines
item.description: Global tech layoffs topped 139,000 in 2026, yet US BLS payrolls rose 885,000. How WARN notices, SEC filings, and India EPFO rules separate cuts from noise.

item.title: India IT Headcount vs. GCC Hiring in 2026: The Real Split
item.description: India's top five IT firms shed 6,981 net roles in FY26, yet GCCs leased 19.2M sq ft in H1 2026. Q2 headcount shifts, EPFO ceiling math, and hiring reality.

item.title: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): Affected Java Builds & Fix
item.description: Oracle Java SE 17–27 and GraalVM face CVE-2026-114938 (Java4Shell) on AVX-512 x86-64 CPUs. Affected builds, JVM flags, and CERT-In CIAD-2026-0061 fixes.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped AI Model Built for Laptops
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling 2 Mini, an Apache 2.0 26.4B looped transformer scoring 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified in a 20GB laptop footprint.

item.title: AI-Generated Code: Why Critics Say It Must Be Open Source
item.description: Exploring the debate on why AI-generated code should default to open source, legal precedents in the US and India, and local developer costs.

item.title: Nvidia Circular Financing: Inside the $530B Demand Engine
item.description: An in-depth analysis of NVIDIA's circular financing strategy, the $105B OpenAI Ohio deal, and the internal rift that led to Jensen Huang's resignation.

item.title: Nvidia Scarcity Allegations: Did It Fund Its Own GPU Sales?
item.description: Investigating allegations that Nvidia engineered GPU scarcity by funding AI startups to buy its own chips, and what this means for global and Indian markets.

item.title: Dwarf Planet Candidate 2026 ED138 Found Orbiting Beyond Pluto
item.description: Astronomers have discovered 2026 ED138, a potential dwarf planet with a 282-year orbit, hiding in the Milky Way's glare. Here is the science and the India angle.

item.title: Term Sheet, Please: Inside the YC Startup Funding Game
item.description: An inside look at Term Sheet, Please, the browser game parodying Papers, Please, alongside an analysis of Y Combinator's shifting India footprint.

item.title: Smart Home Local Control: Why Your Devices Must Work Offline
item.description: A decade of smart home automation reveals why cloud-dependent devices fail and how local-first architectures like MQTT, Tasmota, and Matter 1.4 are fixing it.

item.title: Google Gemini Routes Private Drive Files to Human Annotators
item.description: Google updated its terms to confirm personal Gmail and Drive files processed by Gemini are routed to human reviewers and stored for up to three years.

item.title: Claude Code vs Pi: Why Developers Are Swapping Terminal Agents
item.description: A viral shift from Anthropic's Claude Code to the open-source Pi coding agent exposes developer frustration with tool bloat and high API token costs.

item.title: Discord Kills Electron: Inside the 70% Leaner Rust Rebuild
item.description: Discord's new Rust client cuts RAM by 70% to 290MB and boots in under a second on Windows 11. Here is how the native rebuild works, and what it changes.

item.title: OpenAI Slows Down AI Training: What's Actually Paused, and Why
item.description: OpenAI paused frontier RL training after Astra showed misalignment signs and neared a critical cyber threshold. What is on hold, why now, and the India impact.

item.title: ChatGPT for Teens: What It Blocks, and How It Knows Your Age
item.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT for Teens is rolling out to ages 13–17 with blocked content, Study Mode and parental controls. How age prediction decides, and the India catch.

item.title: Nvidia's $105B OpenAI Deal: The Ohio Guarantee, Explained
item.description: Nvidia will guarantee up to $105 billion for phase one of OpenAI's 8 GW Ohio campus — down from a $250 billion ask. The filing, the site, and the full tally.

item.title: Anthropic Revenue: $11.5B Q2 Report, 14x Growth, IPO Stakes
item.description: Documents viewed by Bloomberg put Anthropic's Q2 2026 revenue above $11.5 billion, up 14-fold, with a first positive adjusted quarter — and a $2T IPO question.

item.title: DeepSeek API Price Hike: New Rates, Peak Hours, Real Math
item.description: DeepSeek's V4 API prices rise about 50% to over 1,100% from 16:00 UTC on August 16. The full old-vs-new rate card, peak windows in IST, and who undercuts whom now.
